CA.rationale: A processing/attention-like origin (command_estimate) is explicitly bound to the same content referent and attribute.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is listed separately from explicit origin/organization metadata for the same referent/time.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Processing/attention-like labels (command_estimate, native_conditional_record, candidate/current peaks) are explicitly linked to specific content referents.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers and attributes (red/blue sets) are listed with referent names.

D.rationale: Origin/organization metadata are given separately from the content lists for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation metadata describe how each content entry is organized/presented (kinds, represented_time, inherited tags).
